name: Collocations
description: Words that naturally go together: verb and noun combinations, adjective and noun pairs, adverb intensifiers and fixed expressions.

passages.title: Getting Ready for an Exam
passages.content:
Before my English exam, I decided to (1) ______ a plan. Every evening I (2) ______ my homework first and then revised for an hour. On Saturdays I (3) ______ a break and went cycling.

The night before the exam I (4) ______ an early night. In the end I (5) ______ my best, and I passed.

passages.title: A Difficult Decision
passages.content:
Last year my friend Roman had to (1) ______ a difficult decision: to stay in his small town or move to Kyiv for university. He (2) ______ a lot of thought to it and talked to everyone he trusted.

His grandmother told him not to (3) ______ any notice of what other people said. In the end he (4) ______ a risk and moved. Now he says that it (5) ______ all the difference.

passages.title: Keeping in Touch
passages.content:
My grandparents live in a village without a good internet (1) ______, so we cannot talk on video. Instead, my grandmother and I (2) ______ letters every month, and she always tells me the latest (3) ______ from the village.

Last winter she (4) ______ a bad cold, and I sent her a card to wish her a quick (5) ______.

passages.title: Running a Small Bakery
passages.content:
When Svitlana opened her bakery, she knew it would be hard to (1) ______ ends meet during the first year. She worked long hours and (2) ______ great attention to every detail.

Word of her cinnamon rolls soon (3) ______ around the neighbourhood. Within two years the bakery had (4) ______ a profit, and she was able to (5) ______ two more people.

questions.title: Which verb goes with 'a decision'?
questions.explanation: «Make a decision» — усталене сполучення; «do» тут не вживають.

questions.title: Which verb goes with 'homework'?
questions.explanation: «Do homework» — усталене сполучення для виконання завдання.

questions.title: Which verb goes with 'a photograph'?
Which verb goes with 'a shower'?
Complete the phrase: to ___ a mistake.
questions.explanation: «Make a mistake» — усталене сполучення; «do a mistake» є помилкою.

questions.title: Complete the phrase: to ___ progress.
Complete the phrase: to ___ an exam.
Complete the phrase: heavy ___.
questions.explanation: Сильний дощ англійською — «heavy rain», а не «strong rain».

questions.title: Complete the phrase: strong ___.
Which adjective goes with 'friend' to mean somebody you trust completely?
questions.explanation: «Close friend» означає близького друга, якому довіряють.

questions.title: Complete the phrase: to ___ a bus.
questions.explanation: «Catch a bus» означає встигнути на автобус.

questions.title: Complete the phrase: to ___ an effort.
Complete the phrase: to pay ___ to somebody who is speaking.
Match each verb with the noun it goes with.
questions.explanation: Дієслово в колокації обирає традиція вжитку, а не логіка.

questions.title: Match each adjective with the noun it usually describes.
questions.explanation: Кожен прикметник має свій набір іменників.

questions.title: Match each verb with the noun it takes in everyday English.
questions.explanation: Ці дієслова утворюють сталі пари з конкретними іменниками.

questions.title: Match each phrase with the meaning it carries.
questions.explanation: Звороти зі словом «mind» мають різні значення.

questions.title: Match each collocation with the topic it belongs to.
questions.explanation: Багато колокацій закріплені за конкретними темами.

questions.title: The new evidence ___ serious doubts about the original verdict.
questions.explanation: «Raise doubts» — усталене сполучення зі значенням «викликати сумніви».

questions.title: Which verb collocates with 'an opportunity' to mean 'use it fully'?
questions.explanation: «Seize an opportunity» означає скористатися нагодою сповна.

questions.title: The two sides eventually ___ an agreement.
The committee ___ a thorough investigation into the complaint.
Which adjective collocates with 'evidence' to mean 'very persuasive'?
She ___ a great deal of criticism for that remark.
Which phrase means to satisfy a requirement?
The scheme failed to ___ its stated objectives.
Which adverb collocates naturally with 'convinced'?
The new law came into ___ at the beginning of January.
He has a strong ___ of humour, which helps in difficult situations.
Their proposal ___ widespread support among younger voters.
Match each verb with the abstract noun it takes.
questions.explanation: Абстрактні іменники мають свої сталі дієслова.

questions.title: Match each adjective with the noun it collocates with.
questions.explanation: Ці прикметники підсилюють іменник у сталий спосіб.

questions.title: Match each intensifier with the adjective it strengthens.
questions.explanation: Підсилювач добирають до конкретного прикметника, а не навпаки.

questions.title: Match each business collocation with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Ділова англійська має власний набір сталих сполучень.

questions.title: Match each collocation with the sentence it completes.
pairs: She agreed to take responsibility for the error.
They took advantage of the low prices.
The council must take action immediately.
Visitors should take precautions against sunburn.
questions.explanation: Дієслово «take» утворює багато сталих сполучень із різними значеннями.

questions.title: Match each faulty collocation with the correction it needs.
pairs: take a decision quickly in error
questions.explanation: Найтиповіші помилки — заміна дієслова в сталій парі.

questions.title: The report ___ considerable light on the causes of the delay.
The findings ___ serious implications for future policy.
Which phrase means to describe something in very general terms?
The two accounts ___ sharply on one crucial point.
Match each academic collocation with its function.
questions.explanation: Академічна англійська має свій набір сталих сполучень.

questions.title: Match each formal collocation with its plain equivalent.
questions.explanation: Формальні звороти мають прості розмовні відповідники.

questions.title: Match each noun with the verb that goes before it in formal English.
questions.explanation: Кожен іменник має своє характерне дієслово.

questions.title: Match each collocation with the degree of intensity it signals.
questions.explanation: Ці прикметники точно градуюють міру зміни.

questions.title: Match each phrase with the attitude it conveys about a proposal.
questions.explanation: Сталий зворот передає ставлення мовця до пропозиції.
